title: QL-1.02 Mutation gate: the changed lines are broken on purpose and the tests must catch every mutant
request: Closes quality-loop principle 2 (a test that survives a mutation is a weak test). Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: SR-0.03. Quality-loop principle set of 30 October 2026 (owner's order: implement as a gate for all dev).

tasks.title: Mutation runner over the diff
requirements: scripts/gate/mutate.mjs takes --base <sha> and --test <cmd>, lists the lines added or changed between base and the working tree in src/**/*.mjs, and applies one mutation at a time from a fixed operator set: === and !==, < and >=, > and <=, && and ||, true and false, + and - on numeric operands, a return value replaced by undefined, a call statement removed

before any mutant it runs the test command twice on the unmutated tree; a failure or a differing pass count there is NOISE and the run stops with exit 2, never judging a mutant (the twin's ME-MT oracle was confounded without this control)
each mutant runs in a temporary copy of the workdir that is removed in a finally block; the original tree is byte-identical after the run (checked by hashing the scope files before and after)

--json prints {mutants, killed, survived, noise, survivors:[{file,line,operator}]}; exit 1 when any mutant survives; a line carrying the comment mutate-ignore with a reason is skipped and counted as ignored
the script has no dependencies and its first line carries a version: comment

criteria.statement: On a fixture whose test checks the changed comparison the mutant is killed; on a fixture whose test only checks that a function returns, the mutant survives and the run exits 1; a flaky fixture stops with NOISE before any mutant

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

tasks.title: Every code contract carries the mutation criterion
requirements: the attest lint used by memev contract new warns when an implement task whose scope includes src/** has no metric criterion on scripts/gate/mutate.mjs with key survived, op ==, value 0
docs/CONTRACTS.md shows the criterion to copy and states that a test that survives a mutation is a weak test

criteria.statement: A draft with an implement task touching src and no mutation criterion gets the warning; one with it gets none
The contracts page carries the criterion and the weak-test rule
